title: Fright Night #8 Now Comics 1989 Revenge of Evil Ed Photo Cover Stephen Geoffreys
conditionDescription: Covers bright and glossy with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. A white sticker/label remnant in the lower-left corner box of the front cover (see photo 1). Light handling wear.
descriptionText:
Fright Night #8 (June 1989), Now Comics - "The Revenge of Evil Ed!" Photo cover of Stephen Geoffreys as Evil Ed from the Fright Night movie. Comics Code approved. Original $1.75 cover price ($2.25 in Canada).

Back cover: Tiger Electronics Double Dragon LCD handheld game ad (1989).

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
